verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a CLI that gives "AI agents and scripts full access" to workspaces. It also offers a programmatic API surface: the Pipelines and Track APIs for data in, and the App API for triggering broadcasts and transactional sends. A published OpenAPI spec and per-integration API keys round this out, so it can be scripted headlessly without the UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g. non-interactive/service-account auth for the CLI, CI examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CLI use.
